_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). A name and a one-line flavour for each fighter's six energy techniques (light volley, medium lob, heavy technique, energy grab, mine or trap, chargeable beam), with an alternate name for Orb, and three call-outs a fighter (grab, a half-charge beam release, a full-charge release). Orb's brief: docs/ep/vision.md, 'Energy attacks overhaul'. Version 2 (2026-10-23): re-fitted to Combat's energy map as the EP forwarded it (see `combat_map`); Combat's one-pagers are still to follow. Names follow the place-plus-verb default, never a franchise echo; flavour and call-outs are in the fighter's voice (voice bibles) and pass the lint. Claude-written; unmarked by Orb; unscreened by Legal.

PROTAGONIST.grab: a net that yanks him into reach
PROTAGONIST.medium: level 2 bounces once toward the foe
PROTAGONIST.trap: a pillar that throws a tripper up and away

RIVAL.grab: a ring that binds his arms (never cuts)
RIVAL.beam: a sheaf of thin drilling lances
RIVAL.trap: a pressure plate firing a fan of needles

EMPRESS.grab: a cage of banners that slams him down to kneel
EMPRESS.medium: a thrown crown that clings and goes off 20 ticks later
EMPRESS.beam: a thin sweeping cut from the mantle hem or blade-hand
EMPRESS.trap: a line across the air that fires her level-1 beam

CYBORG.grab: a crane-hook lash that throws him 6 bh
CYBORG.medium: molten slag that rolls along the ground
CYBORG.beam: a ragged, unstable beam vented from the furnace
CYBORG.trap: a scrap-jaw field that drags a passer down

medium.label: Medium lob
medium.means: a more substantial explosive blast, lobbed

grab.label: Energy grab
grab.means: a unique catch: net, ring, banners, hook

trap.label: Mine or trap
trap.means: left behind when a block meets an energy attack

light.name: Knuckle Flick
light.flavour: Quick sparks off my knuckles. Catch!

medium.name: Pier Lob
medium.flavour: Thrown high, it bounces once toward you.

heavy.name: Whole Palm
heavy.flavour: Everything in one open hand. Brace yourself!

grab.name: Harbour Net
grab.flavour: I throw a net and haul you in!

trap.name: Trip Pillar
trap.flavour: Block, and the ground springs up under your feet.

beam.name: Breakwater
beam.flavour: A wide wall of heat. It drives you back!

light.name: Pin Volley
light.flavour: Thin needles, one after another. Count them.

medium.name: Stair Split
medium.flavour: One blast, three steps down. Count them.

heavy.name: Rank Breaker
heavy.flavour: This one sorts the amateurs from the rest.

trap.name: Pressure Plate
trap.flavour: Step wrong, clown. A fan of needles pops.

beam.name: Lance Sheaf
beam.flavour: Thin lances, bundled tight. They drill, not cut.

light.name: Silk Sparks
light.flavour: Pretty little sparks, rat. Do try to keep up!

medium.name: Crown Toss
medium.flavour: Gahaha! We toss a crown. It clings, then bangs!

heavy.name: Throne Quake
heavy.flavour: The ground bows when we stamp. Hahaha!

grab.name: Banner Snare
grab.flavour: Our banners cage you, rat, and you kneel.

trap.name: Velvet Rope
trap.flavour: Cross our velvet rope and the beam fires.

beam.name: Hem Sweep
beam.flavour: A thin cut from the hem. It sweeps everything!

light.name: Rivet Spray
light.flavour: Spitting hot rivets! Small bites, big hunger!

medium.name: Slag Roll
medium.flavour: Hot slag, rolling your way. Mind your feet!

heavy.name: Wrecker Swing
heavy.flavour: Chassis swings, wreckage flies. Duck, snack!

grab.name: Crane Hook
grab.flavour: Hook's out! I'll throw you across the yard!

trap.name: Scrap Jaw
trap.flavour: Block, and the scrap behind me grows teeth.

beam.name: Furnace Vent
beam.flavour: Limiter off. It vents out ragged and hot!

PROTAGONIST.text: All of it! Catch this one!

RIVAL.text: Full sheaf, clown. Try to dodge.

EMPRESS.text: Gahaha! Kneel in our cage, rat!
Hahaha! A thin cut for the rat!

CYBORG.text: Hook's out! Throwing you clear across!
